questions.question: Why did Figma disable its AI 'Make Designs' tool after launch?
questions.answer_summary: Figma disabled it after it produced app designs nearly identical to Apple's Weather app; CEO Dylan Field said 'Ultimately it is my fault for not insisting on a better QA process,' and paused the feature pending further QA.

questions.question: Is Figma Make good enough to replace a dedicated AI design tool?
questions.answer_summary: Many practitioners say no — one commenter called it 'incredibly underwhelming... basically just Gemini 3 Pro with a design prompt,' and others noted it 'generates pages that ignore your components, skip your tokens.'

questions.question: How does Figma Make compare specifically to Claude Design?
questions.answer_summary: A widely discussed comparison argued Figma Make runs on a weaker underlying model than Claude Design and that Claude Design's one-click import of an existing design system produces more professional, on-brand results.

questions.question: Does an AI design tool need to respect existing design tokens/components to be useful for real teams?
questions.answer_summary: Practitioners argue yes — criticism of Figma Make centers on it treating 'every screen like a fresh snowflake' instead of reusing the team's actual component library and tokens.

questions.question: What other AI design tools compete with Figma's built-in AI features?
questions.answer_summary: Named alternatives include Claude Design (Anthropic), v0 by Vercel, Magic Patterns (YC W23, 185 pts/114 comments on HN), Brilliant.design (a Figma alternative where 'AI works with vector primitives, not code'), and Mowgli ('Figma for the agent era' with Claude Code integration).

questions.question: Why do a lot of AI-generated UIs end up looking the same regardless of which tool made them?
questions.answer_summary: One commenter attributed this to many teams and tools defaulting to the same off-the-shelf CSS/component library (e.g. shadcn) as a shared starting point.

questions.question: Did Figma's AI stumbles create an opening for competitors like Anthropic?
questions.answer_summary: Commentary framed it as a structural disadvantage: Figma pays for the same AI inference it competes against, while smaller dedicated competitors have near-zero marginal shipping costs.

questions.question: What does Figma Make actually do, mechanically?
questions.answer_summary: Figma positions Make as prompt-to-prototype generation that stays visually editable on canvas and can pull in 'Make kits' or existing Figma frames as design-system context.

questions.question: Can non-designers get professional-looking results from a dedicated AI design tool?
questions.answer_summary: One reviewer argued yes for Claude Design specifically, saying it lets non-designers 'create professional outputs matching corporate design standards,' partly via one-click import of an existing design system.
